# What this ticket asks for, and what is already true

Three of the five criteria are partly or wholly satisfied already, and saying so is cheaper than
rediscovering it halfway through.

**Already true.** No file under `.claude/skills/seene-harness`, `.agents/skills/seene-harness` or
`.harness-drafts/SEENE-*` exists: the Seene project was removed in SEEN-086's first commit and the
repository's history was rebuilt from a fresh root, so those paths have never existed here. The
criterion is met and the ticket records why rather than pretending work was done.

`.claude/settings.json` already carries the command allowlist, added by SEEN-090.

`CLAUDE.md` already links `docs/harness/workflow.md` and lists the harness commands, though the list
is out of date: it names `doctor | start | status | history | draft | note | check | advance | graph |
decide | return | verify-delivery | report | sync`, and the harness has since gained `coverage`,
`lint`, `discard`, `reopen` and `verify-merge`, while `sync` does not exist yet.

**Not true yet.** `docs/harness/skill.md` does not exist, so there is nothing to sync and no `sync`
command. And no ticket has run through all five stages as a deliberate reference example: eight have
run through them for real, which is better evidence, but none is labelled as the example a new session
should read.

**The dry run needs a subject.** A trivial ticket that exists only to be worked would leave a journal
about nothing. SEEN-092 itself is the better candidate: it goes through all five stages, it delivers,
and its journal is the reference. The criterion is amended to say that, because inventing SEEN-093 as
a toy would put a fake ticket in the backlog for ever.
